name: Chocoliel
source:
"Chocolate is both sweet and bitter; it's a symbol of life!"

The main heroine of this game (though it doesn't say you can romance her). A Valentine's Day angel gives the protagonist, who lost his life due to the "uncontrolled power of love," a second chance. However, her own actions and words are full of things to criticize. Apparently, she loves chocolate mint.

[Translated from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20250518184944/https://g.28gou.net/valentinus/#characters]official website[/url]]
